## Proposed January 15 Deadline for H-1B Registration Intake

For the upcoming cap season, I propose setting January 15 as our internal deadline for H-1B registration intake, with engagement letters and a one-page questionnaire going out the week of December 7. This would give employers a clear timetable and give us more room to review information, resolve gaps, and prepare before the registration window opens.

Last season, we filed 14 registrations for six employer clients; nine of those registrations came in during the final week of February. Rosa logged roughly 11 hours of overtime the week the window opened. That concentration of work largely reflects our current process: we send the questionnaire whenever an employer asks, without setting an intake date. One HR contact said she would happily have sent everything in January if we had asked. This is an opportunity to offer better service through clearer expectations, not a response to clients being late.

An earlier deadline also reduces our risk. Registration itself is straightforward, but errors can have expensive consequences, including the risk of an invalid selection if passport information is wrong. Brightwater Analytics sent a beneficiary’s passport scan two days before the window opened; it had expired in October, and we caught it because Rosa checked the dates. We should build time for that review into the schedule rather than depend on last-minute checks.

The proposed changes are:
- Send engagement letters and the one-page questionnaire the week of December 7, clearly stating the January 15 intake deadline.
- Have Rosa own the intake tracker, with a clean six weeks after January 15 to chase gaps and flag unresolved issues.
- Handle requests received after January 15 case by case, based on capacity and whether we can complete a reliable review.

January 15 is realistic: HR teams are back from the holidays, budgets are set, and employers already plan for the $215-per-beneficiary registration fee in Q1. If Marcus agrees on Thursday, we can finalize the timetable and client language in time to send the December letters.
